Early development release of NicoClient, an independent launcher and Fabric mod for Minecraft Java 1.21.11.

**Coming next:**
- **Import mods:** the Mods page finds mods in your normal Minecraft folder and imports them in one click. It copies only Fabric 1.21.11 mods that are not there yet, and never touches the originals.
- Mods dropped into the folder show up at once, and the list names Forge mods, mods for other versions and stray .zip files that would not load.
- **Trajectories:** the block your shot will hit glows red (Glow on the block it hits, in its settings).

**New in 0.8.0: profiles, notifications and a smarter HUD editor.**
- **Profiles:** save your modules, settings and HUD layout under a name and switch with one click. Four presets come with it: PvP, Survival, Performance and Minimal. Open them in the game (Right Shift, then Profiles) or apply them from the launcher's Home page. Cosmetics are never changed by a profile.
- **Notifications:** switching a module by its key, saving a waypoint or loading a profile shows a small animated card above the hotbar.
- **HUD editor:** modules snap to the screen edges, the middle and other modules, with a guide line while you drag. Hold Shift to place freely, and use the arrow keys to move the last module by one (five with Shift).
- **Waypoint menu on M:** press M during play to add a waypoint where you stand or on the block you look at, click one to rename it, recolor, hide or delete it, and switch all markers on or off at the top. An arrow next to each one points the way, and the NicoClient menu has a Waypoints button too. The key can be changed in Minecraft's Controls or in NicoClient (Waypoints settings, Menu key); both stay the same.
- A running game now also takes HUD positions and key bindings from changes made in the launcher.

**0.7.0: a new launcher.** A fresh design with a moving background, a bigger PLAY button and a Play button in the sidebar.
- Switch twelve popular modules right from the Home page, and see your cosmetics there.
- Pick the accent color, HUD size and Server-safe mode in Settings. The color applies to the launcher and the game; a running game follows within two seconds.
- Filter Modrinth mods by Performance, Utility, Decoration, Storage and Libraries.
- **Server-safe mode** (on by default) pauses Freelook and Trajectories on public servers, where they are often not allowed. Singleplayer and LAN are not affected.
- Installed mods switch on and off with a switch; short messages in the corner confirm every change.
- Keys: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+4 switch pages, / jumps to the mod search.
- The in-game menu shows a small tile per module, its hotkey, and your face and name.

**0.6.1:** a Cosmetics tab in the launcher. Pick capes, wings, halos and trails with picture previews; a running game takes them over within two seconds.

**New in 0.6.0: Cosmetics.** Open the menu with Right Shift and press Cosmetics. A 3D preview of your player turns while you choose.
- 11 capes: Nebula, Flame, Ocean, Nico, Aurora, Sakura, Rainbow, Ice, Gold, Carbon, Lava.
- 7 wings: Angel, Dragon, Neon, Butterfly, Phoenix, Crystal, Bat.
- 4 halos and 5 particle trails.
- Only you can see your cosmetics; other players do not.

The module menu also got a cleaner look. Version 0.5.0 added waypoints, Target HUD and 15 more modules.

**Install:** download `NicoClient-Setup-*.exe` below and run it. The installer is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning: choose More info, then Run anyway.

**You need:** Windows 64-bit, the official Minecraft Launcher and your own Minecraft Java account.

**Play:** press PLAY, choose the NicoClient Fabric 1.21.11 profile in the official launcher and start it. In the game, Right Shift opens the menu.

**Updates:** NicoClient downloads new versions on its own and installs them on restart.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
